UI_quick_tip_FL_001: Fight on cleared ground with room to retreat, not in a cramped kitchen.
UI_quick_tip_FL_002: Separate a small encounter from the crowd before you commit to swinging.
UI_quick_tip_FL_003: Leave a gap behind you; backing into a wall can end a controlled fight.
UI_quick_tip_FL_004: A shove can buy space when a zombie gets inside your weapon's reach.
UI_quick_tip_FL_005: Check behind you between encounters, even on a street you cleared earlier.
UI_quick_tip_FL_006: Fence crossings can knock zombies down, but their lunges are still dangerous.
UI_quick_tip_FL_007: Carry a usable backup weapon before your main one reaches breaking point.
UI_quick_tip_FL_008: Learn your weapon's reach against isolated targets, not a surrounding crowd.
UI_quick_tip_FL_009: If swings become ineffective, retreat and check your condition before retrying.
UI_quick_tip_FL_010: Do not let a finishing stomp distract you from a second approaching zombie.
UI_quick_tip_FL_011: Healthy survivors can often walk away from shamblers; sprinters change that.
UI_quick_tip_FL_012: Save your sprint for a closing gap instead of spending it on routine travel.
UI_quick_tip_FL_013: Break sight, then change direction; one corner is not proof you lost pursuit.
UI_quick_tip_FL_014: Scout the far side of a fence before making it your escape route.
UI_quick_tip_FL_015: Heavy loads can spoil a fence escape. Leave room in your carrying budget.
UI_quick_tip_FL_016: Crouching reduces your profile; it does not make you invisible up close.
UI_quick_tip_FL_017: A dense forest can hide your pursuers and your next obstacle. Plan ahead.
UI_quick_tip_FL_018: Know where you will retreat before you attract a group away from loot.
UI_quick_tip_FL_019: Avoid sprinting through clutter when a clear street offers another route.
UI_quick_tip_FL_020: A blocked escape route is a reason to abandon the loot objective.
UI_quick_tip_FL_021: Sleepiness and exertion are different problems; a short rest is not sleep.
UI_quick_tip_FL_022: Read a new moodle's tooltip before you decide to keep fighting.
UI_quick_tip_FL_023: Build 42 muscle strain is a reason to shorten fights and change activities.
UI_quick_tip_FL_024: Rest somewhere secure before low endurance becomes an emergency.
UI_quick_tip_FL_025: Check clothing and temperature when your survivor keeps overheating.
UI_quick_tip_FL_026: A bigger backpack does not remove the risks of an overloaded survivor.
UI_quick_tip_FL_027: Return trips need energy too. Start heading home before you are spent.
UI_quick_tip_FL_028: Schedule exercise before a recovery period, not before a dangerous raid.
UI_quick_tip_FL_029: Pain and injuries can explain poor combat even when your weapon is sound.
UI_quick_tip_FL_030: Choose today's job around your condition instead of yesterday's plan.
UI_quick_tip_FL_031: Give each trip a short shopping list so low-value loot does not bury it.
UI_quick_tip_FL_032: A working weapon, drinking water and bandages matter more than rare trophies.
UI_quick_tip_FL_033: Keep emergency supplies accessible instead of buried in a bag on the floor.
UI_quick_tip_FL_034: Equipped bags reduce carried item weight, but their reduction is not unlimited.
UI_quick_tip_FL_035: Leave some capacity for the item you actually came to find.
UI_quick_tip_FL_036: Mark promising buildings and return prepared rather than taking everything.
UI_quick_tip_FL_037: Check nearby rooms before settling into a long inventory transfer.
UI_quick_tip_FL_038: A flashlight and spare batteries make darkness a smaller surprise.
UI_quick_tip_FL_039: Prioritize tools for your next project instead of hoarding every duplicate.
UI_quick_tip_FL_040: Keep a small return-home supply separate from loot you plan to discard.
UI_quick_tip_FL_041: Check every room before calling a building your safe place to sleep.
UI_quick_tip_FL_042: Cover exposed windows before turning a temporary shelter into home.
UI_quick_tip_FL_043: Choose a fallback exit before barricading your main entrance.
UI_quick_tip_FL_044: A sheet-rope exit can be torn down. Recheck it before relying on it.
UI_quick_tip_FL_045: Remove remaining window glass before using that opening as a route.
UI_quick_tip_FL_046: A quiet location can be worth more than a large building full of storage.
UI_quick_tip_FL_047: Keep a second refuge stocked in case your main shelter becomes unsafe.
UI_quick_tip_FL_048: Do not assume a tall fence makes the whole property permanently safe.
UI_quick_tip_FL_049: Store an emergency kit where you can reach it without crossing the house.
UI_quick_tip_FL_050: Keep your entrance and escape path clear of your own stored clutter.
UI_quick_tip_FL_051: Fill useful containers while the taps work instead of waiting for shutoff.
UI_quick_tip_FL_052: Check the water's contamination label before drinking from a new source.
UI_quick_tip_FL_053: Rain collection supplies water, not a promise of drinkable water.
UI_quick_tip_FL_054: Treat tainted water and confirm its status has changed before drinking.
UI_quick_tip_FL_055: Use a suitable cooking container when boiling a batch of unsafe water.
UI_quick_tip_FL_056: Keep a clean reserve for travel rather than carrying only untreated water.
UI_quick_tip_FL_057: Do not assume plumbing has purified the water arriving at a sink.
UI_quick_tip_FL_058: A renewable water source still needs a safe collection and treatment route.
UI_quick_tip_FL_059: Refill before a long journey; finding an empty bottle is not finding water.
UI_quick_tip_FL_060: Check auto-drink settings and keep your drinking container accessible.
UI_quick_tip_FL_061: Use perishables while they are fresh and keep a shelf-stable reserve.
UI_quick_tip_FL_062: A powered freezer slows spoilage; plan for the day that power stops.
UI_quick_tip_FL_063: Check food condition before eating an item left behind on an old trip.
UI_quick_tip_FL_064: Watch the cooking progress instead of leaving a meal on a running stove.
UI_quick_tip_FL_065: Switch cooking appliances off before you leave the shelter.
UI_quick_tip_FL_066: A full stomach and a stable body weight are not the same thing.
UI_quick_tip_FL_067: Watch your weight trend when living on a narrow range of foods.
UI_quick_tip_FL_068: Carry a way to open the canned food you pack for a journey.
UI_quick_tip_FL_069: Check the actual recipe for preservation supplies before harvesting a surplus.
UI_quick_tip_FL_070: Keep spare food while learning farming or fishing; a new system takes time.
UI_quick_tip_FL_071: Get out of immediate danger, then stop bleeding before resuming your trip.
UI_quick_tip_FL_072: Keep spare clean bandages on your character, not only in your vehicle.
UI_quick_tip_FL_073: Inspect the Health panel after an injury instead of guessing what happened.
UI_quick_tip_FL_074: An ordinary wound-infection label is not a diagnosis of the Knox virus.
UI_quick_tip_FL_075: Do not treat disinfectant as a cure for zombie transmission.
UI_quick_tip_FL_076: Check footwear before crossing broken glass or rough ground.
UI_quick_tip_FL_077: Inspect damaged clothing; old protection ratings may no longer apply.
UI_quick_tip_FL_078: Treat an injured hand or leg as a change to your combat or travel plan.
UI_quick_tip_FL_079: Choose a secure treatment location before starting a longer medical action.
UI_quick_tip_FL_080: Replenish your first-aid kit after a close call, not during the next one.
UI_quick_tip_FL_081: Inspect fuel, battery and engine condition before betting your escape on a car.
UI_quick_tip_FL_082: Check tires and hood condition as well as whether the engine starts.
UI_quick_tip_FL_083: Park with a clear departure route rather than facing a wall or a crowd.
UI_quick_tip_FL_084: Slow down before blind corners and wrecks, not after they fill the screen.
UI_quick_tip_FL_085: Keep a small emergency kit on your person in case you must abandon the car.
UI_quick_tip_FL_086: Repeated zombie impacts damage the vehicle you depend on for transport.
UI_quick_tip_FL_087: A noisy engine can bring company to the place where you stop.
UI_quick_tip_FL_088: Make sure the side you plan to exit is clear before leaving your seat.
UI_quick_tip_FL_089: Keep fuel resupply in your route plan before you explore farther afield.
UI_quick_tip_FL_090: Inspect your car again after a collision, even if it still drives.
UI_quick_tip_FL_091: Use the current crafting search instead of relying on an old recipe list.
UI_quick_tip_FL_092: Check required skills, tools and work surfaces before hauling materials home.
UI_quick_tip_FL_093: Some recipes need a hard surface nearby; loose ingredients are not enough.
UI_quick_tip_FL_094: Read recipe literature when you find it, then confirm what it unlocked.
UI_quick_tip_FL_095: Store project supplies together so a missing small item is easy to spot.
UI_quick_tip_FL_096: Choose one useful project before trying to learn every crafting branch.
UI_quick_tip_FL_097: Check a recipe's output before spending scarce ingredients on a substitute.
UI_quick_tip_FL_098: Keep a serviceable tool in reserve when a project depends on that tool.
UI_quick_tip_FL_099: Use recovery time for reading or planning instead of another long fight.
UI_quick_tip_FL_100: Recheck requirements after an update; Build 41 instructions may no longer fit.
UI_quick_tip_FL_101: Run generators outdoors; opening an indoor window is not a safety plan.
UI_quick_tip_FL_102: Learn the current generator requirements before the electricity fails.
UI_quick_tip_FL_103: Plan both fuel and maintenance supplies before depending on a generator.
UI_quick_tip_FL_104: A generator adds noise as well as power. Consider what is nearby.
UI_quick_tip_FL_105: Keep an independent light source for a power failure or a fuel shortage.
UI_quick_tip_FL_106: Make water and food plans that still function without refrigeration.
UI_quick_tip_FL_107: Do not use a fire-clearing tactic beside the shelter you need to preserve.
UI_quick_tip_FL_108: Check burning appliances and fires before sleeping or leaving the area.
UI_quick_tip_FL_109: Store critical supplies in more than one place in case fire destroys a base.
UI_quick_tip_FL_110: Keep a clear path away from a fire instead of trapping yourself behind it.
UI_quick_tip_FL_111: Check a crop's current planting information before spending your seeds.
UI_quick_tip_FL_112: Keep food reserves while crops mature; planting does not feed you tonight.
UI_quick_tip_FL_113: Plan animal feed and water before bringing livestock back to your base.
UI_quick_tip_FL_114: Inspect animal water supplies before leaving on a long expedition.
UI_quick_tip_FL_115: Farming, animals and exploration compete for time. Grow your workload slowly.
UI_quick_tip_FL_116: Balance clothing protection with heat and movement for the job ahead.
UI_quick_tip_FL_117: Recheck nearby threats when returning from a trip; yesterday's path can change.
UI_quick_tip_FL_118: Read your sandbox settings; advice for shamblers may fail with sprinters.
UI_quick_tip_FL_119: Treat a modded mechanic as something to check, not a vanilla guarantee.
UI_quick_tip_FL_120: If a plan costs your escape route, change the plan before the zombies do.
